title: U.S. Army Special Forces Order of Battle, Vietnam Theater (1957–1975)
citation: Stephen Sherman, U.S. Army Special Forces Order of Battle Vietnam Theater (1957-1975), RADIX Press, 1995. Part 1 of 3, 118 pp (item 4030205001); Part 2 of 3, 134 pp (item 4030205002). Chuck Carlock Collection, association Rattler/Firebird Association, Vietnam Center and Sam Johnson Vietnam Archive, Texas Tech University. Copyright-restricted; accessed through the Vietnam Reading Room portal.
notes: A compiled reference listing every U.S. Special Forces camp in South Vietnam by name, controlling C-detachment, A-detachment number, grid coordinate, province, and final disposition. Its entry reads 'Nui Ba Den  3  324  XT28105820  Tay Ninh  Closed', making it the fourth independent source for Detachment A-324 at the mountain. It also records that the Xuan Loc camp, Det A-353 in Long Khanh, was 'Relocated to Nui Ba Den'. A narrow right-hand column of personal names is clipped and interleaved in the scan's text layer, so no name in it can be attributed to a particular camp without consulting the page image.
